::: info TOP-RIGHT-CLEAR
**Nothing tappable in the top right corner**

Leave the top right corner clear of anything tappable.

**Why.** The host floats one small round button there, over the application, and it is how a person reaches the menu.

<small>Applies to every shape · not checked by anything · [TOP-RIGHT-CLEAR in Constraints](/docs/constraints#TOP-RIGHT-CLEAR)</small>
:::
